entries.reason: rank 635, class_confirmed for telegram
entries.effect: kept; at capture a format not in availablePreviewPhotoPixelFormatTypes, or a width without a height or the other way round, raises NSInvalidArgumentException; otherwise the still is decoded (a JPEG through ImageIO's thumbnail, an uncompressed buffer through CoreImage) and drawn into a 32BGRA pixel buffer whose longest side is the larger of the width and height asked, held to the display's, or the display's when none is asked, keeping the photo's aspect ratio, and delivered as previewPhotoSampleBuffer

entries.effect: made by -capturePhotoWithSettings:delegate: before -captureOutput:willBeginCaptureForResolvedSettings:, from the camera and the still about to be taken (from the still once it comes, and willBeginCapture sent then, when the port has no format yet or the flash may fire), and handed as one object to every callback of the request; every member the SDK 16.4 header declares answers explicitly (AVCaptureResolvedPhotoSettings.m), where an earlier version carried uniqueID alone and let the compiler synthesize the other properties to zeros
